title: Thorn
name: Marlene
description: A blind duelist who fights by ear, the Thorn holds her ground and lets the battle come to her. In her defensive stance she is a sentinel—listening, marking, and shielding allies from blows they don't see coming; with her blade drawn she becomes a lethal fencer, parrying and answering every attack with a precise riposte. She has turned her condition into a discipline, training her sighted companions to move and fight in darkness. But her mastery is built on a fixed point in space: she will not maneuver mid-battle, and a blow she fails to sense can shatter her focus entirely.
history: The Thorn was once 'the Rose'—champion fencer and favourite of a great lady of the court, celebrated before adoring crowds. Her sight was taken in a duel by an unremarkable opponent she had beaten before. Discarded by the court, she spent long years lost before slowly rebuilding herself through relentless discipline, trading a champion's gift for a fencer's drilled mastery.
summary: A blind former court champion who rebuilt herself into a patient, vigilant duelist and teacher, sharper now than she was celebrated.

appearance.features: Pale, sightless eyes beneath her blindfold

clothing.head: Red blindfold
clothing.body: Brown leather duelist's coat with red fastenings

notes: Does not tolerate pity regarding her condition
The Rose still lingers within her, still relishing the memory of applause
Perceives the world through hearing and scent, and teaches others to do the same
